gdd.title: The Legend of Deborah — Garry's Mod Game Design Document

rules.text: P opens the shared non-pausing Player Menu directly to the Character Sheet tab. The Player Menu contains five first-class tabs: Character Sheet, Inventory + Spellbook, Die Log, Instruction Booklet, and Options. LOD-UI-OPTIONS-001 [SOURCE IMPLEMENTED; NATIVE ACCEPTANCE PENDING]: Options is the extensible home for saved player preferences: Event cue volume, Always Run, Reduced effects, Third-person camera, Map size and Map opacity. The retired streamed Music controls remain removed. Third-person camera is a saved desktop checkbox, default Off; use the existing behind-player placement with collision protection and preserve aiming/FOV, VR, vehicles, spectating and authored cinematic views. Map size is a saved continuous slider from 0.5 to 1.5 times the current map, default 1.0. Map opacity is a separate saved continuous slider from 0 (transparent) to 1 (the current opacity), default 1.0. Size and opacity affect the entire map together, including text, markers and quadrant overlays; keep the panel within the window without changing the saved requested scale. These presentation preferences apply immediately, survive reconnects and Hero changes, and never change map access, Magic costs, map data, combat or server rules. First-person view and the existing map appearance remain the defaults. Reuse the existing camera placement constants rather than introducing new camera tuning. Always Run defaults Off (hold Shift to run); On means run by default and hold Shift to walk, honoring rebound keys without changing other Shift shortcuts or legal movement speeds. Preferences persist across sessions and Hero changes. Full rules: HUMAN anchor Player Options — Music and Always Run. P, I, and L remain direct-open/switch bindings for Character Sheet, Inventory + Spellbook, and Die Log respectively rather than separate overlapping windows. No dedicated default direct-open key is currently authored for Instruction Booklet; once the Player Menu is open, the player reaches it through the same tab-navigation controls as the other pages. For cooperative Heroes the Character Sheet displays identity, class, Level/XP, abilities/growth, derived stats including current FinalDodgeChance plus ordinary-tier and elevated-tier DodgeChance projections for the shared 25%-walk / 90%-sprint horizontal-speed ladder when different/nonzero, progression HP rolls, feats/capstone, Form/Content ownership and other authored current fields. For human Soldiers it exposes the current automatically generated/developed Soldier profile read-only, including Level, SoldierXP/next legal threshold, class, abilities, HP, feats, Content/capstone state and relevant derived stats including DodgeChance when applicable. The Player Menu never pauses gameplay or grants safety.

I opens the shared Player Menu directly to the Inventory + Spellbook tab for all cooperative Hero classes. Six Forms remain on the top row; RAW plus unlocked Contents remain on the bottom row; Content permission is class-neutral. Inventory + Spellbook must use the same Instruction-Booklet/Character-Sheet visual grammar, typography, paper field, heading hierarchy, tab treatment, spacing, and information-pane conventions as the Character Sheet. See 03.
LOD-UI-006 — INSTRUCTION BOOKLET PLAYER-MENU TAB [CURRENT REQUIRED]

Instruction Booklet is the fourth first-class tab of the shared non-pausing Player Menu and is required for the RPG Update. It exposes the canonical in-game rules booklet during active maze play so a player is not limited to consulting it in the Hermit staging hut. The staging-hut booklet and the Player Menu Instruction Booklet tab are two access paths to one canonical manual content source: they must render the same current pages, rules text, controls, diagrams and illustrations rather than maintain duplicate independently editable copies. Cooperative Heroes and human Soldiers may consult the tab anywhere ordinary Player Menu access is legal; opening or reading it never pauses gameplay, grants invulnerability, changes movement/combat state, or otherwise creates safety. No dedicated default direct-open key is currently authored for this tab; P, I and L retain their existing direct-open meanings and the booklet is reached through ordinary tab navigation after opening the Player Menu. The tab uses the same Instruction-Booklet/Character-Sheet visual grammar as the other Player Menu pages and must ship synchronized with the final RPG Update manual reconciliation under LOD-IMPL-007.
